mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses risk-free rates and reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative equity returns as consumer spending and corporate earnings face sustained pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate synchronized demand-supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO rise >0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1450.0 thousand units indicate strengthening consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through improved economic sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1450.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment (PAYEMS) falling below 140,000 thousand persons signals labor market contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to recessionary risk escalation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when PAYEMS is below 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) rising >0.5% combined with FEDFUNDS falling below 0.15% indicates strong consumer demand amid monetary accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS rises >0.5% and FEDFUNDS falls <0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 index level indicates recessionary supply contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0.
